concerns_or_questions_summary: Currently on L-1A with approved I-140 (PD Nov 2025) and selected in H-1B lottery; employer is only doing change-of-status. Wants to avoid H-1B auto-activation on Oct 1 (to preserve spouse's L-2S work authorization) by traveling to Canada Sep 28 and re-entering Oct 2-3 so the last action rule keeps L-1A status. Asks whether this travel plan works and whether the same approved H-1B petition can be activated as a COS later if needed.
